products.body:
The Fiddichside 28 Year Old 1997 is an exceptional blended malt Scotch whisky bottled by Murray McDavid for the prestigious Mission Gold series. Paying homage to the rich heritage of Speyside, this unique expression is predominantly composed of malts from the iconic Glenfiddich Distillery. Matured in Pedro Ximénez sherry casks for remarkable depth and sweetness, it was bottled as a limited edition of 510 bottles, offering a refined tribute to Speyside’s most celebrated whisky traditions.

Why We Think You’ll Love It

  • Matured for 28 years in Pedro Ximénez sherry casks

  • Bottled by Murray McDavid for the Mission Gold series

  • Predominantly features malts from the iconic Glenfiddich Distillery

  • Limited edition release of just 510 bottles

  • A luxurious Speyside tribute with rich sherry depth and heritage character

The Fiddichside 28 Year Old 1997 Murray McDavid Mission Gold is a rare blended malt that celebrates Speyside’s whisky legacy. With its Glenfiddich-led profile, PX sherry richness, and nearly three decades of maturation, it delivers a dram of elegance, history, and collectible value

products.body:
Glen Moray 18 Year Old 2007 is a beautifully mature Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, bottled for the Fragrant Drops series. Distilled in 2007 and bottled in 2026, this exceptional single cask expression has matured in a single refill bourbon barrel (#6357), allowing the distillery’s elegant spirit character to shine with remarkable clarity. Bottled at a natural 54.1% ABV, this limited release offers a refined and authentic Speyside whisky experience.

The refill bourbon barrel provides a gentle maturation, preserving Glen Moray’s naturally fruity and floral spirit while adding subtle layers of vanilla, honey, coconut, and delicate oak spice. After 18 years, the whisky has developed impressive depth and complexity without overwhelming the distillery character. Bottled without chill-filtration or added colour, this single cask release is a superb example of mature bourbon-matured Speyside whisky.

Why We Think You’ll Love It

  • 18 year old Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from Glen Moray
  • Matured in a single refill bourbon barrel (#6357)
  • Distilled 2007, bottled 2026
  • Bottled at natural cask strength: 54.1% ABV
  • Part of the Fragrant Drops series
  • Non chill-filtered and natural colour for exceptional flavour and mouthfeel

The Glen Moray 18 Year Old 2007 Fragrant Drops is an elegant and beautifully matured Speyside single malt, showcasing Glen Moray’s refined fruit character through the gentle influence of refill bourbon oak. Smooth, complex, and wonderfully balanced, it’s an outstanding whisky for enthusiasts seeking classic bourbon-matured Scotch whisky and exceptional single cask releases.

products.body:
Experience the pinnacle of GlenAllachie’s core range with GlenAllachie 18 Year Old. Hand-selected by Billy Walker, the whisky is built around long-matured spirit from 1st-fill Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheons, balanced with a parcel of well-seasoned American-oak barrels to retain bright orchard fruit. Bottled at 46 % ABV, non-chill-filtered and natural in colour, this expression delivers velvet richness, polished oak and layered complexity that only eighteen patient years can provide.

Why We Think You’ll Love It

  • Full sherry influence: Oloroso for nutty depth, PX for lush dark-fruit richness—balanced by subtle bourbon cask brightness.

  • Bottled at 46 % ABV, non-chill-filtered and natural colour for maximum texture, aroma and authenticity.

  • Combines GlenAllachie’s orchard-fruit DNA with decades-deep oak finesse—ideal for contemplative sipping.

  • A flawless showcase of Billy Walker’s cask-selection mastery and a benchmark for modern, mature Speyside single malts.

Pour a dram of GlenAllachie 18 Year Old and savour an exquisite harmony of honeyed fruit, sumptuous sherry and polished oak—an unforgettable Speyside indulgence that lingers long after the final sip.

products.body:
Glen Moray 18 Year Old 2007 Unicorn is a single cask Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, bottled exclusively for The Whisky Barrel as part of the acclaimed Unicorn Series. Distilled in 2007 and bottled in 2026, this 18 year old Glen Moray was matured in a first-fill Pedro Ximénez quarter cask #TWB153, yielding just 162 bottles at natural cask strength of 52.4% ABV. Presented at natural colour and without chill filtration, it is a rich and highly individual expression of this classic Elgin distillery.

Glen Moray is known for its soft, fruit-led Speyside character, and the concentrated influence of a first-fill PX quarter cask brings considerable richness and intensity. Expect layers of raisins, figs, dark chocolate, treacle and warming spice alongside orchard fruits, honeyed malt and citrus. After 18 years of maturation, the whisky shows impressive integration, with the smaller quarter cask format adding depth while preserving the elegant character of the spirit.

The bespoke label continues the storytelling at the heart of The Whisky Barrel Unicorn Series, depicting the unicorn overlooking the town of Elgin and its historic cathedral. The artwork also gives a subtle nod to the distinctive vintage Glen Moray presentation tins released through the 1980s, 1990s and 2000s, many of which famously featured imagery inspired by the Royal Highland regiments. It is a fitting reference to both the distillery's home town and a memorable piece of Glen Moray's packaging heritage.

Why We Think You’ll Love It

  • 18 year old single cask Glen Moray Speyside single malt Scotch whisky

  • Distilled in 2007 and bottled in 2026

  • Matured in first-fill Pedro Ximénez quarter cask #TWB153

  • Exceptionally limited release of just 162 bottles

  • Bottled at natural cask strength of 52.4% ABV

  • Natural colour and non-chill filtered

  • Bottled exclusively for The Whisky Barrel

  • Part of The Whisky Barrel's acclaimed Unicorn Series

  • Combines Glen Moray's elegant Speyside character with rich PX sherry influence

  • Bespoke artwork featuring Elgin, its cathedral and a nod to vintage Glen Moray regimental presentation tins

The Glen Moray 18 Year Old 2007 Unicorn is a distinctive single cask Speyside malt, bringing together mature Glen Moray spirit, concentrated Pedro Ximénez richness and a label inspired by the distillery's Elgin heritage. With only 162 bottles drawn from first-fill PX quarter cask #TWB153 at 52.4% ABV, it is an excellent choice for enthusiasts and collectors of Glen Moray whisky, PX sherry cask Scotch, cask strength Speyside single malt, independent bottlings, and The Whisky Barrel Unicorn Series.

GlenDronach 26 Year Old 1992 Exclusive for TWB is a remarkable Highland single malt Scotch whisky, drawn from a single Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheon #8315. Distilled in 1992 and bottled in June 2018, this exceptional release was specially selected and bottled exclusively for The Whisky Barrel. Limited to just 720 individually numbered bottles, it showcases the luxurious depth and intensity of GlenDronach’s famed sherry cask style.

Why We Think You’ll Love It

  • Matured for 26 years in a single Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheon

  • Exclusively bottled for The Whisky Barrel

  • Limited to just 720 numbered bottles

  • A classic example of GlenDronach’s intensely sherried, opulent style

An indulgent and collectible sherry bomb from one of Scotland’s most iconic distilleries.
